title: 识别已检出的 Git LFS 指针并校验恢复模型制品
source: 独立编审：Git特有历史与交付故障
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 保全工作区与历史证据

conversion.original_title: 发布包中的模型只有三行version、oid和size文本，提交检出成功；运行时无法加载模型。如何演练处置？

body:
## 操作任务
实现inspect_model(path)识别规范Git LFS指针并提取SHA256/size，不能把指针文本报告为可加载模型。实现restore_model(pointer_path,object_path)：只接受哈希和长度都匹配的本地对象，在目标同目录原子替换；校验失败时指针原字节保留。合同使用真实临时Git仓库证明commit/checkout干净不代表LFS对象存在；禁止访问网络。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
创建隔离临时Git仓库，复现干净检出LFS指针但模型加载失败；校验本地对象SHA256/长度后原子恢复。

## 能力边界
本地用真实Git记录和检出LFS指针格式，不访问远端LFS服务。检测到指针只证明元数据可读，不代表模型对象已下载；恢复只接受可信本地对象且匹配SHA256与size，原子替换成功后应由部署流程另行决定是否提交。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: Git LFS pointer verification',flush=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',pathlib.Path('task.py'))
task=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(task)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='lfs pointer ') as d:
 root=pathlib.Path(d);repo=root/'repo';repo.mkdir();model=repo/'model.bin';object_store=root/'objects';object_store.mkdir();object_path=object_store/'expected-model'
 payload=b'MODEL\x00'+bytes(range(64))*8;object_path.write_bytes(payload);digest=hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
 pointer=(f'version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1\noid sha256:{digest}\nsize {len(payload)}\n').encode();model.write_bytes(pointer)
 env={**os.environ,'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM':'1','GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL':str(root/'gitconfig')}
 def git(*args):return subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),*args],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=5)
 assert git('init','-q').returncode==0
 assert git('config','user.name','OpsForge Test').returncode==0 and git('config','user.email','opsforge@example.invalid').returncode==0
 assert git('add','--','model.bin').returncode==0 and git('commit','-qm','publish model pointer').returncode==0
 assert git('status','--porcelain').stdout=='' and git('show','HEAD:model.bin').stdout.encode()==pointer,'checkout should be clean but contain pointer text'
 def load_model(path):
  data=path.read_bytes()
  if data.startswith(b'version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1'):raise ValueError('LFS pointer is not model data')
  if not data.startswith(b'MODEL\x00'):raise ValueError('invalid model magic')
  return data
 try:load_model(model)
 except ValueError as e:assert 'LFS pointer' in str(e)
 else:raise AssertionError('pointer unexpectedly loaded as model')
 detected=task.inspect_model(model);assert detected=={'status':'pointer','loadable':False,'sha256':digest,'size':len(payload)},detected
 corrupt=object_store/'corrupt';corrupt.write_bytes(b'X'*len(payload))
 try:task.restore_model(model,corrupt)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('corrupt object accepted')
 assert model.read_bytes()==pointer,'failed verification must preserve pointer'
 restored=task.restore_model(model,object_path)
 assert restored=={'status':'artifact','loadable':True,'sha256':digest,'size':len(payload)},restored
 assert load_model(model)==payload and not list(repo.glob('.model.bin.*.tmp'))
 assert git('diff','--quiet','--','model.bin').returncode==1,'restoration must be visible as a worktree change'

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
